description: Add belongings (furniture, clothing, jewelry, tools, collections, household goods) to the estate's one "Household and personal items" list — several per call. Use this, NOT create_asset, for personal belongings: each is a row of that list, not its own asset, and the list has one short task set. An item worth more than $5,000, a firearm, or a titled vehicle/boat is moved to its own asset automatically (the result says which). Value and recipient are optional; record a recipient only when the customer named who gets it. Adds rows to the estate's Household and personal items list. An item over $5,000, a firearm or a titled vehicle becomes its own asset instead; for eligible paid estates a new list or separate asset may start task preparation. Repeating within a few minutes adds nothing.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

name: add_household_items
